```diff
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useMemo} from 'react'
+ import {MapboxOverlay} from '@deck.gl/mapbox'
+ import type {DeckProps} from '../types'
+ 
+ // Create a DeckGL overlay for Mapbox to integrate deck.gl layers with Mapbox
+ export function DeckGLOverlay({layers}: DeckProps) {
+   const overlay = useMemo(() =&gt; new MapboxOverlay({layers}), [layers])
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div
+       id='deck-gl-overlay'
+       ref={(el) =&gt; {
+         if (el) {
+           // This is a workaround to attach the overlay to the map
+           const mapDiv = el.parentNode
+           if (mapDiv &amp;&amp; mapDiv.classList.contains('mapboxgl-map')) {
+             const map = (mapDiv as any)._map
+             if (map &amp;&amp; !map.__deck) {
+               map.addControl(overlay)
+               map.__deck = true
+             }
+           }
+         }
+       }}
+     /&gt;
+   )
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ import type { GeoJSONFeature, FilterOptions } from "../types";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Determines if a sighting is a significant event based on properties
+  */
+ export const isSignificantEvent = (feature: GeoJSONFeature): boolean =&gt; {
+ 	// Safety check
+ 	if (!feature || !feature.properties) return false;
+ 
+ 	// Define criteria for "significant events"
+ 
+ 	// 1. Events with longer durations (more than 10 minutes)
+ 	const durationSeconds = Number.parseInt(
+ 		feature.properties.duration_seconds || "0",
+ 		10,
+ 	);
+ 	if (durationSeconds &gt; 600) return true;
+ 
+ 	// 2. Events with multiple witnesses or officially documented
+ 	const description = (feature.properties.description || "").toLowerCase();
+ 	if (
+ 		description.includes("multiple witness") ||
+ 		description.includes("military") ||
+ 		description.includes("pilot") ||
+ 		description.includes("police") ||
+ 		description.includes("radar") ||
+ 		description.includes("official")
+ 	)
+ 		return true;
+ 
+ 	// 3. Events that have media evidence
+ 	if (feature.properties.video || feature.properties.image) return true;
+ 
+ 	// 4. Famous historical cases
+ 	const location = (feature.properties.location || "").toLowerCase();
+ 	if (
+ 		description.includes("roswell") ||
+ 		description.includes("phoenix lights") ||
+ 		description.includes("nimitz") ||
+ 		description.includes("tic tac") ||
+ 		description.includes("rendlesham") ||
+ 		location.includes("roswell") ||
+ 		location.includes("phoenix")
+ 	)
+ 		return true;
+ 
+ 	return false;
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Combined filter function for sightings data
+  */
+ export const filterFeature = (
+ 	feature: GeoJSONFeature,
+ 	timeRange: [number, number],
+ 	filters: FilterOptions,
+ 	isSignificantEventFn = isSignificantEvent,
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	// Safety check
+ 	if (!feature || !feature.properties) return false;
+ 
+ 	// Get the date from either date or timestamp property
+ 	const date = new Date(
+ 		feature.properties.date || feature.properties.timestamp || 0,
+ 	);
+ 	const timestamp = date.getTime();
+ 
+ 	// Check if it's within the selected time range (always applied)
+ 	if (timestamp &lt; timeRange[0] || timestamp &gt; timeRange[1]) return false;
+ 
+ 	const {
+ 		shape: featureShape,
+ 		duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
+ 		country: featureCountry,
+ 		state: featureState,
+ 	} = feature.properties;
+ 
+ 	// Shape filter
+ 	if (
+ 		filters.shape &amp;&amp;
+ 		featureShape &amp;&amp;
+ 		featureShape.toLowerCase() !== filters.shape.toLowerCase()
+ 	) {
+ 		return false;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Duration filter (convert string to number if needed)
+ 	if (filters.duration &gt; 0) {
+ 		const duration =
+ 			typeof durationSeconds === "string"
+ 				? Number.parseInt(durationSeconds, 10)
+ 				: durationSeconds || 0;
+ 
+ 		if (duration &lt; filters.duration) return false;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Country filter
+ 	if (
+ 		filters.country &amp;&amp;
+ 		featureCountry &amp;&amp;
+ 		featureCountry.toLowerCase() !== filters.country.toLowerCase()
+ 	) {
+ 		return false;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// State filter
+ 	if (
+ 		filters.state &amp;&amp;
+ 		featureState &amp;&amp;
+ 		featureState.toLowerCase() !== filters.state.toLowerCase()
+ 	) {
+ 		return false;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Significant events filter
+ 	if (filters.isSignificantEvent &amp;&amp; !isSignificantEventFn(feature)) {
+ 		return false;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Feature passed all filters
+ 	return true;
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Find significant events within a specific time window
+  */
+ export const findSignificantEventsInTimeWindow = (
+ 	sightings: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection | null,
+ 	start: number,
+ 	end: number,
+ 	isSignificantEventFn = isSignificantEvent,
+ ): GeoJSONFeature[] =&gt; {
+ 	if (!sightings || !sightings.features) return [];
+ 
+ 	return sightings.features.filter((feature: any) =&gt; {
+ 		// Check if it's in the time window
+ 		const date = new Date(
+ 			feature.properties.date || feature.properties.timestamp || 0,
+ 		);
+ 		const timestamp = date.getTime();
+ 		if (timestamp &lt; start || timestamp &gt; end) return false;
+ 
+ 		// Check if it's a significant event
+ 		return isSignificantEventFn(feature as GeoJSONFeature);
+ 	}) as GeoJSONFeature[];
+ };
+
```

```diff
+ import type { MapConfig } from "../types";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Fly to a specific location on the map
+  */
+ export const flyToLocation = (
+ 	longitude: number,
+ 	latitude: number,
+ 	zoom = 5,
+ 	mapConfig: MapConfig,
+ 	setMapConfig: (config: MapConfig) =&gt; void,
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	setMapConfig({
+ 		...mapConfig,
+ 		center: [longitude, latitude] as [number, number],
+ 		zoom: [zoom] as [number],
+ 	});
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Gets the user's current geolocation
+  */
+ export const getUserLocation = (
+ 	mapConfig: MapConfig,
+ 	setMapConfig: (config: MapConfig) =&gt; void,
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	if ("geolocation" in navigator) {
+ 		navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
+ 			(position) =&gt; {
+ 				setMapConfig({
+ 					...mapConfig,
+ 					center: [position.coords.longitude, position.coords.latitude] as [
+ 						number,
+ 						number,
+ 					],
+ 					zoom: [6] as [number],
+ 				});
+ 			},
+ 			(error) =&gt; {
+ 				console.error("Error getting user location:", error);
+ 			},
+ 		);
+ 	}
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Load Mapbox tileset for sightings
+  */
+ export const loadMapboxTileset = (
+ 	mapRef: React.RefObject&lt;any&gt;,
+ 	mapLoaded: boolean,
+ 	setPopupInfo: (
+ 		info: {
+ 			coordinates: [number, number];
+ 			properties: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;
+ 		} | null,
+ 	) =&gt; void,
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	if (!mapRef.current || !mapLoaded) return;
+ 
+ 	// Access map differently depending on react-map-gl version
+ 	const mapInstance = mapRef.current.getMap
+ 		? mapRef.current.getMap()
+ 		: mapRef.current._map
+ 			? mapRef.current._map
+ 			: mapRef.current;
+ 
+ 	// Ensure the map is fully initialized and has required methods
+ 	if (!mapInstance) {
+ 		console.error("Map instance is not available yet");
+ 		return;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	if (typeof mapInstance.getSource !== "function") {
+ 		console.error(
+ 			"Map instance does not have getSource method, map might not be fully loaded",
+ 		);
+ 		return;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	try {
+ 		// Remove previous sources/layers if they exist
+ 		if (mapInstance.getSource("sightings-tileset")) {
+ 			if (mapInstance.getLayer("sightings-points"))
+ 				mapInstance.removeLayer("sightings-points");
+ 			mapInstance.removeSource("sightings-tileset");
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Add the tileset source
+ 		mapInstance.addSource("sightings-tileset", {
+ 			type: "vector",
+ 			url: "mapbox://ellisliam.35z8vcnh",
+ 		});
+ 
+ 		// Add a layer for the sightings points
+ 		mapInstance.addLayer({
+ 			id: "sightings-points",
+ 			type: "circle",
+ 			source: "sightings-tileset",
+ 			"source-layer": "sightings", // This should match your tileset source layer name
+ 			paint: {
+ 				"circle-radius": 6,
+ 				"circle-color": "#ff8c00",
+ 				"circle-opacity": 0.8,
+ 				"circle-stroke-width": 2,
+ 				"circle-stroke-color": "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)",
+ 			},
+ 		});
+ 
+ 		// Add click handler for the points
+ 		mapInstance.on("click", "sightings-points", (e: any) =&gt; {
+ 			if (e.features &amp;&amp; e.features.length &gt; 0) {
+ 				const feature = e.features[0];
+ 				setPopupInfo({
+ 					coordinates: feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number],
+ 					properties: feature.properties,
+ 				});
+ 			}
+ 		});
+ 
+ 		// Change cursor on hover
+ 		mapInstance.on("mouseenter", "sightings-points", () =&gt; {
+ 			mapInstance.getCanvas().style.cursor = "pointer";
+ 		});
+ 
+ 		mapInstance.on("mouseleave", "sightings-points", () =&gt; {
+ 			mapInstance.getCanvas().style.cursor = "";
+ 		});
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error loading Mapbox tileset:", error);
+ 	}
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Format date for display
+  */
+ export const formatDate = (timestamp: number | string | undefined) =&gt; {
+ 	if (!timestamp) return "Unknown date";
+ 	const date = new Date(timestamp);
+ 	return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
+ 		year: "numeric",
+ 		month: "long",
+ 		day: "numeric",
+ 	}).format(date);
+ };
+
```

```diff
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useCallback} from 'react'
+ import {GeoJsonLayer, HexagonLayer, HeatmapLayer, ScatterplotLayer} from 'deck.gl'
+ import {scaleLog} from 'd3-scale'
+ import type {GeoJSONFeature, FeatureInfo} from '../types'
+ import AnimatedArcGroupLayer from '../animated-arc-group-layer'
+ import {AnimatedArcLayer} from '../animated-arc-layer'
+ 
+ type PopupInfoSetter = (info: FeatureInfo | null) =&gt; void
+ type HoverInfoSetter = (info: (FeatureInfo &amp; {x: number; y: number}) | null) =&gt; void
+ 
+ interface UseVisualizationLayersProps {
+   filteredSightings: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection | null
+   visualizationMode: string
+   mapLoaded: boolean
+   showMilitaryBases: boolean
+   showUFOPosts: boolean
+   arcAnimationEnabled: boolean
+   militaryBases?: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection | null
+   ufoPosts?: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection | null
+   setPopupInfo: PopupInfoSetter
+   setHoverInfo: HoverInfoSetter
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook to build deck.gl visualization layers
+  */
+ export function useVisualizationLayers({
+   filteredSightings,
+   visualizationMode,
+   mapLoaded,
+   showMilitaryBases,
+   showUFOPosts,
+   arcAnimationEnabled,
+   militaryBases,
+   ufoPosts,
+   setPopupInfo,
+   setHoverInfo,
+ }: UseVisualizationLayersProps) {
+   // Create a color scale for the heatmap
+   const colorScale = useCallback(
+     () =&gt;
+       scaleLog()
+         .domain([1, 10, 100, 1000])
+         // @ts-ignore - d3 types mismatch
+         .range([
+           [65, 182, 196],
+           [127, 205, 187],
+           [199, 233, 180],
+           [255, 255, 204],
+         ]),
+     []
+   )
+
```

```diff
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {useRef, useState, useEffect} from 'react'
+ import {loadMapboxTileset} from '../utils/map-utils'
+ 
+ interface UseMapInitializationProps {
+   useTileset: boolean
+   mapLoaded: boolean
+   setMapLoaded: (loaded: boolean) =&gt; void
+   setPopupInfo: (info: any | null) =&gt; void
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hook to handle map initialization and loading
+  */
+ export function useMapInitialization({
+   useTileset,
+   mapLoaded,
+   setMapLoaded,
+   setPopupInfo,
+ }: UseMapInitializationProps) {
+   const mapRef = useRef(null)
+ 
+   // Handle map initialization when the component mounts
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     // Cancel if mapRef is not ready
+     if (!mapRef.current) return
+ 
+     let mounted = true
+     let mapInstance = null
+     let retryCount = 0
+     const MAX_RETRIES = 10 // Prevent infinite retries
+ 
+     // Function to safely get the map instance
+     const getMapInstance = () =&gt; {
+       try {
+         if (!mapRef.current) return null
+ 
+         // Access map differently depending on react-map-gl version
+         return mapRef.current.getMap
+           ? mapRef.current.getMap()
+           : mapRef.current._map
+           ? mapRef.current._map
+           : mapRef.current
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error('Error getting map instance:', error)
+         return null
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     // Function to handle map loaded state
+     const handleMapLoad = () =&gt; {
+       if (!mounted) return
+ 
+       console.log('Map loaded successfully')
+ 
+       // Double-check that we have a valid map instance with required methods
+       const instance = getMapInstance()
+       if (instance &amp;&amp; typeof instance.getSource === 'function') {
+         setMapLoaded(true)
+ 
+         // If using tileset mode, load the Mapbox tileset
+         if (useTileset) {
+           setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+             if (mounted) loadMapboxTileset(mapRef, mapLoaded, setPopupInfo)
+           }, 100) // Small delay to ensure map is fully ready
+         }
+       } else {
+         // If the map instance doesn't have getSource yet, try again after a short delay
+         // but limit retries to prevent infinite loops
+         if (retryCount &lt; MAX_RETRIES) {
+           console.warn(
+             &#96;Map instance loaded but methods not available yet, retrying... (${
+               retryCount + 1
+             }/${MAX_RETRIES})&#96;
+           )
+           retryCount++
+           setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+             if (mounted) handleMapLoad()
+           }, 200)
+         } else {
+           console.error('Max retries reached while waiting for map methods to become available')
+           // Force the map to be considered loaded after max retries
+           setMapLoaded(true)
+         }
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     // Get map instance and check its state
+     const checkMapInstance = () =&gt; {
+       if (retryCount &gt;= MAX_RETRIES) {
+         console.error('Max retries reached while waiting for map instance')
+         // Force the map to be considered loaded after max retries
+         setMapLoaded(true)
+         return
+       }
+ 
+       mapInstance = getMapInstance()
+ 
+       if (!mapInstance) {
+         // If no instance yet, retry after a delay
+         retryCount++
+         setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+           if (mounted) checkMapInstance()
+         }, 200)
+         return
+       }
+ 
+       // Check if the map is already loaded
+       if (typeof mapInstance.loaded === 'function' &amp;&amp; mapInstance.loaded()) {
+         handleMapLoad()
+       } else if (typeof mapInstance.on === 'function') {
+         // Listen for load event
+         mapInstance.on('load', handleMapLoad)
+         // Also set a backup timeout in case the event doesn't fire
+         setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+           if (mounted &amp;&amp; !mapLoaded) {
+             console.log('Map load event not fired, forcing load check')
+             handleMapLoad()
+           }
+         }, 2000)
+       } else {
+         // Fallback - retry after a short delay, but only a limited number of times
+         retryCount++
+         console.warn(
+           &#96;Map instance has no loaded method, retrying... (${retryCount}/${MAX_RETRIES})&#96;
+         )
+         if (retryCount &lt; MAX_RETRIES) {
+           setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+             if (mounted) checkMapInstance()
+           }, 200)
+         } else {
+           console.error('Max retries reached. Assuming map is ready.')
+           // Force the map to be considered loaded after max retries
+           setMapLoaded(true)
+         }
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     // Start checking for map instance
+     checkMapInstance()
+ 
+     // Cleanup function
+     return () =&gt; {
+       mounted = false
+       // Remove event listener if possible
+       if (mapInstance &amp;&amp; typeof mapInstance.off === 'function') {
+         try {
+           mapInstance.off('load', handleMapLoad)
+         } catch (error) {
+           console.error('Error cleaning up map event listener:', error)
+         }
+       }
+     }
+   }, [useTileset, mapLoaded, setMapLoaded, setPopupInfo])
+ 
+   return {mapRef}
+ }
+
```

```diff
+         renderChildrenInPortal={true}&gt;
+         {/* Navigation controls */}
+         &lt;ZoomControl position='top-left' /&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Add deck.gl overlay for advanced visualizations */}
+         {(visualizationMode === 'heatmap' ||
+           visualizationMode === 'hexagon' ||
+           visualizationMode === 'scatter' ||
+           visualizationMode === 'arcs' ||
+           visualizationMode === 'both') &amp;&amp;
+           filteredSightings &amp;&amp;
+           mapLoaded &amp;&amp; &lt;DeckGLOverlay layers={deckLayers} /&gt;}
+ 
+         {/* Fallback for sightings layer if deck.gl isn't used for some reason */}
+         {visualizationMode !== 'native' &amp;&amp;
+           visualizationMode !== 'tileset' &amp;&amp;
+           !['heatmap', 'hexagon', 'scatter', 'arcs', 'both'].includes(visualizationMode) &amp;&amp;
+           filteredSightings &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;Layer
+               type='circle'
+               id='sightings-layer'
+               paint={{
+                 'circle-radius': 6,
+                 'circle-color': '#ff8c00',
+                 'circle-opacity': 0.8,
+                 'circle-stroke-width': 2,
+                 'circle-stroke-color': 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
+               }}&gt;
+               {filteredSightings.features.map((feature: GeoJSONFeature, index: number) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;Feature
+                   key={&#96;sighting-${feature.properties.id || index}&#96;}
+                   coordinates={feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number]}
+                   onClick={() =&gt;
+                     setPopupInfo({
+                       coordinates: feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number],
+                       properties: feature.properties,
+                     })
+                   }
+                 /&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/Layer&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+         {/* Military bases layer */}
+         {showMilitaryBases &amp;&amp; militaryBases &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;Layer
+             type='circle'
+             id='military-bases-layer'
+             paint={{
+               'circle-radius': 8,
+               'circle-color': '#0000ff',
+               'circle-opacity': 0.7,
+               'circle-stroke-width': 1,
+               'circle-stroke-color': '#ffffff',
+             }}&gt;
+             {militaryBases.features.map((feature: any, index: number) =&gt; (
+               &lt;Feature
+                 key={&#96;base-${feature.properties.id || index}&#96;}
+                 coordinates={feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number]}
+                 onClick={() =&gt;
+                   setPopupInfo({
+                     coordinates: feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number],
+                     properties: feature.properties,
+                   })
+                 }
+               /&gt;
+             ))}
+           &lt;/Layer&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {/* UFO posts layer */}
+         {showUFOPosts &amp;&amp; ufoPosts &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;Layer
+             type='circle'
+             id='ufo-posts-layer'
+             paint={{
+               'circle-radius': 5,
+               'circle-color': '#8000ff',
+               'circle-opacity': 0.7,
+               'circle-stroke-width': 1,
+               'circle-stroke-color': '#ffffff',
+             }}&gt;
+             {ufoPosts.features.map((feature: any, index: number) =&gt; (
+               &lt;Feature
+                 key={&#96;post-${feature.properties.id || index}&#96;}
+                 coordinates={feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number]}
+                 onClick={() =&gt;
+                   setPopupInfo({
+                     coordinates: feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number],
+                     properties: feature.properties,
+                   })
+                 }
+               /&gt;
+             ))}
+           &lt;/Layer&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {/* Popup for selected feature */}
+         {popupInfo &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;Popup
+             coordinates={popupInfo.coordinates}
+             offset={[0, -15]}
+             onClick={() =&gt; setPopupInfo(null)}&gt;
+             &lt;div className='p-2 max-w-md bg-black bg-opacity-80 text-white rounded-md border border-cyan-500/30 relative'&gt;
+               {/* Special highlight for significant events */}
+               {currentHighlightedEvent &amp;&amp;
+               popupInfo.properties.id === currentHighlightedEvent.properties.id ? (
+                 &lt;div className='absolute -top-2 -left-2 px-2 py-0.5 bg-yellow-500 text-black text-xs font-bold rounded'&gt;
+                   Major Event
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               ) : null}
+ 
+               &lt;h3 className='text-lg font-bold mb-1 text-cyan-400'&gt;
+                 {popupInfo.properties.city || popupInfo.properties.location || 'Unknown location'}
+               &lt;/h3&gt;
+ 
+               {/* Date and time with shape if available */}
+               &lt;div className='flex justify-between items-center mb-2'&gt;
+                 &lt;p className='text-sm'&gt;
+                   {formatDate(popupInfo.properties.date || popupInfo.properties.timestamp)}
+                 &lt;/p&gt;
+                 {popupInfo.properties.shape &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;span className='text-xs px-2 py-0.5 bg-gray-700 rounded-full'&gt;
+                     {popupInfo.properties.shape}
+                   &lt;/span&gt;
+                 )}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+               {/* Duration if available */}
+               {popupInfo.properties.duration_hours_min &amp;&amp; (
+                 &lt;p className='text-xs mb-2 text-cyan-300'&gt;
+                   Duration: {popupInfo.properties.duration_hours_min}
+                 &lt;/p&gt;
+               )}
+ 
+               {/* Main description */}
+               &lt;p className='text-sm'&gt;
+                 {popupInfo.properties.description ||
+                   popupInfo.properties.comments ||
+                   'No description available'}
+               &lt;/p&gt;
+ 
+               {/* Footer with source and metadata */}
+               &lt;div className='mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-gray-700 flex justify-between items-end'&gt;
+                 {popupInfo.properties.sourceUrl &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;a
+                     href={popupInfo.properties.sourceUrl}
+                     target='_blank'
+                     rel='noopener noreferrer'
+                     className='text-xs text-cyan-400 underline inline-block'&gt;
+                     Source
+                   &lt;/a&gt;
+                 )}
+ 
+                 {/* Reported date if different from event date */}
+                 {popupInfo.properties.reported_date &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;span className='text-xs text-gray-400'&gt;
+                     Reported: {popupInfo.properties.reported_date}
+                   &lt;/span&gt;
+                 )}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+               {/* Media indicators */}
+               {(popupInfo.properties.video || popupInfo.properties.image) &amp;&amp; (
+                 &lt;div className='mt-2 flex gap-2'&gt;
+                   {popupInfo.properties.image &amp;&amp; (
+                     &lt;span className='text-xs bg-indigo-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded'&gt;📷 Photo&lt;/span&gt;
+                   )}
+                   {popupInfo.properties.video &amp;&amp; (
+                     &lt;span className='text-xs bg-red-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded'&gt;🎥 Video&lt;/span&gt;
+                   )}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               )}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/Popup&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/MapGL&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Controls panel for visualization options */}
+       &lt;div className='absolute bottom-4 left-4 p-4 bg-black bg-opacity-70 text-white rounded-lg z-10 font-monumentMono'&gt;
+         &lt;h3 className='text-lg mb-3 font-bold text-cyan-400'&gt;Visualization Options&lt;/h3&gt;
+ 
+         &lt;div className='mb-3'&gt;
+           &lt;label htmlFor='displayMode' className='block mb-1'&gt;
+             Display Mode
+           &lt;/label&gt;
+           &lt;div id='displayMode' className='flex flex-wrap gap-2'&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt; {
+                 setVisualizationMode('native')
+                 setUseTileset(false)
+                 // Clear any popup info when changing visualization mode
+                 setPopupInfo(null)
+               }}
+               className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                 visualizationMode === 'native' ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-black' : 'bg-gray-700'
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+               Mapbox Clusters
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt; {
+                 setVisualizationMode('tileset')
+                 setUseTileset(true)
+                 setPopupInfo(null)
+               }}
+               className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                 visualizationMode === 'tileset' ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-black' : 'bg-gray-700'
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+               Mapbox Tileset
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt; {
+                 setVisualizationMode('heatmap')
+                 setUseTileset(false)
+                 setPopupInfo(null)
+               }}
+               className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                 visualizationMode === 'heatmap' ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-black' : 'bg-gray-700'
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+               Heatmap
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt; {
+                 setVisualizationMode('hexagon')
+                 setUseTileset(false)
+                 setPopupInfo(null)
+               }}
+               className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                 visualizationMode === 'hexagon' ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-black' : 'bg-gray-700'
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+               3D Clusters
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt; {
+                 setVisualizationMode('scatter')
+                 setUseTileset(false)
+                 setPopupInfo(null)
+               }}
+               className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                 visualizationMode === 'scatter' ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-black' : 'bg-gray-700'
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+               Points
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt; {
+                 setVisualizationMode('arcs')
+                 setUseTileset(false)
+                 setPopupInfo(null)
+               }}
+               className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                 visualizationMode === 'arcs' ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-black' : 'bg-gray-700'
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+               Connections
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt; {
+                 setVisualizationMode('both')
+                 setUseTileset(false)
+                 setPopupInfo(null)
+               }}
+               className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                 visualizationMode === 'both' ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-black' : 'bg-gray-700'
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+               Combined
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Visualization Layers */}
+         &lt;div className='mb-3'&gt;
+           &lt;label htmlFor='layersControl' className='block mb-1'&gt;
+             Layers
+           &lt;/label&gt;
+           &lt;div id='layersControl' className='flex flex-wrap gap-2'&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt; setShowMilitaryBases(!showMilitaryBases)}
+               className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                 showMilitaryBases ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-black' : 'bg-gray-700'
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+               Military Bases
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt; setShowUFOPosts(!showUFOPosts)}
+               className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                 showUFOPosts ? 'bg-cyan-500 text-black' : 'bg-gray-700'
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+               UFO Posts
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+ 
+             {isExternalDataLoaded &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;button
+                 type='button'
+                 onClick={isAnimating ? stopAnimation : startAnimation}
+                 className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                   isAnimating ? 'bg-red-500 text-black' : 'bg-green-600'
+                 }&#96;}&gt;
+                 {isAnimating ? 'Stop Animation' : 'Start Time Animation'}
+               &lt;/button&gt;
+             )}
+ 
+             {isAnimating &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className='px-3 py-1 rounded bg-gray-800 text-cyan-300 flex gap-2 items-center'&gt;
+                 &lt;span&gt;Speed:&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;select
+                   value={animationSpeed}
+                   onChange={(e) =&gt; setAnimationSpeed(Number.parseInt(e.target.value))}
+                   className='bg-gray-900 text-white rounded'&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='250'&gt;4x&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='500'&gt;2x&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='1000'&gt;1x&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='2000'&gt;0.5x&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;/select&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Filtering Controls */}
+         &lt;div className='mb-3'&gt;
+           &lt;div className='flex justify-between items-center'&gt;
+             &lt;label className='block mb-1'&gt;Filters&lt;/label&gt;
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt;
+                 setFilters({
+                   shape: '',
+                   duration: 0,
+                   country: '',
+                   state: '',
+                   isSignificantEvent: false,
+                 })
+               }
+               className='text-xs text-cyan-400 hover:text-cyan-300'&gt;
+               Reset
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           &lt;div className='flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-2'&gt;
+             {/* Significant Events Toggle */}
+             &lt;button
+               type='button'
+               onClick={() =&gt;
+                 setFilters({
+                   ...filters,
+                   isSignificantEvent: !filters.isSignificantEvent,
+                 })
+               }
+               className={&#96;px-3 py-1 rounded ${
+                 filters.isSignificantEvent ? 'bg-yellow-500 text-black' : 'bg-gray-700'
+               }&#96;}&gt;
+               {filters.isSignificantEvent ? 'Major Events Only' : 'All Sightings'}
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+ 
+             {/* Shape Filter - Common shapes dropdown */}
+             &lt;div className='px-3 py-1 rounded bg-gray-800 flex gap-2 items-center'&gt;
+               &lt;span className='text-sm'&gt;Shape:&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;select
+                 value={filters.shape}
+                 onChange={(e) =&gt; setFilters({...filters, shape: e.target.value})}
+                 className='bg-gray-900 text-white rounded text-sm py-0'&gt;
+                 &lt;option value=''&gt;Any&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='cylinder'&gt;Cylinder&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='triangle'&gt;Triangle&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='circle'&gt;Circle&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='disc'&gt;Disc&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='oval'&gt;Oval&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='sphere'&gt;Sphere&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='cigar'&gt;Cigar&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='formation'&gt;Formation&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='light'&gt;Light&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='other'&gt;Other&lt;/option&gt;
+               &lt;/select&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             {/* Duration Filter */}
+             &lt;div className='px-3 py-1 rounded bg-gray-800 flex gap-2 items-center'&gt;
+               &lt;span className='text-sm'&gt;Min Duration:&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;select
+                 value={filters.duration}
+                 onChange={(e) =&gt;
+                   setFilters({
+                     ...filters,
+                     duration: Number.parseInt(e.target.value),
+                   })
+                 }
+                 className='bg-gray-900 text-white rounded text-sm py-0'&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='0'&gt;Any&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='60'&gt;1+ min&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='300'&gt;5+ mins&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='600'&gt;10+ mins&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='1800'&gt;30+ mins&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='3600'&gt;1+ hour&lt;/option&gt;
+               &lt;/select&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {/* Location Filters */}
+           &lt;div className='flex flex-wrap gap-2'&gt;
+             {/* Country Filter */}
+             &lt;div className='px-3 py-1 rounded bg-gray-800 flex gap-2 items-center'&gt;
+               &lt;span className='text-sm'&gt;Country:&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;select
+                 value={filters.country}
+                 onChange={(e) =&gt; setFilters({...filters, country: e.target.value})}
+                 className='bg-gray-900 text-white rounded text-sm py-0'&gt;
+                 &lt;option value=''&gt;Any&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='us'&gt;United States&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='ca'&gt;Canada&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='gb'&gt;United Kingdom&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;option value='au'&gt;Australia&lt;/option&gt;
+               &lt;/select&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             {/* State Filter - show only if US is selected */}
+             {filters.country === 'us' &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className='px-3 py-1 rounded bg-gray-800 flex gap-2 items-center'&gt;
+                 &lt;span className='text-sm'&gt;State:&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;select
+                   value={filters.state}
+                   onChange={(e) =&gt; setFilters({...filters, state: e.target.value})}
+                   className='bg-gray-900 text-white rounded text-sm py-0'&gt;
+                   &lt;option value=''&gt;Any&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='ca'&gt;California&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='tx'&gt;Texas&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='nv'&gt;Nevada&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='az'&gt;Arizona&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='nm'&gt;New Mexico&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='wa'&gt;Washington&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='or'&gt;Oregon&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='fl'&gt;Florida&lt;/option&gt;
+                   &lt;option value='ny'&gt;New York&lt;/option&gt;
+                 &lt;/select&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         &lt;div className='mb-3'&gt;
+           &lt;label htmlFor='timeRange1' className='block mb-1'&gt;
+             Time Period: {formatDate(timeRange[0])} - {formatDate(timeRange[1])}
+           &lt;/label&gt;
+           &lt;input
+             id='timeRange1'
+             type='range'
+             min={new Date('1940-01-01').getTime()}
+             max={new Date().getTime()}
+             value={timeRange[0]}
+             onChange={(e) =&gt; setTimeRange([Number.parseInt(e.target.value), timeRange[1]])}
+             className='w-full mb-2'
+           /&gt;
+           &lt;input
+             id='timeRange2'
+             type='range'
+             min={new Date('1940-01-01').getTime()}
+             max={new Date().getTime()}
+             value={timeRange[1]}
+             onChange={(e) =&gt; setTimeRange([timeRange[0], Number.parseInt(e.target.value)])}
+             className='w-full'
+           /&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         &lt;div className='flex flex-wrap gap-2'&gt;
+           &lt;button
+             type='button'
+             onClick={() =&gt; getUserLocation(mapConfig, setMapConfig)}
+             className='px-3 py-1 rounded bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 transition-colors'&gt;
+             Go to My Location
+           &lt;/button&gt;
+ 
+           {/* Example locations for demo purposes */}
+           &lt;button
+             type='button'
+             onClick={() =&gt; flyToLocation(-112.074, 33.4484, 8, mapConfig, setMapConfig)}
+             className='px-3 py-1 rounded bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 transition-colors'&gt;
+             Phoenix Lights
+           &lt;/button&gt;
+           &lt;button
+             type='button'
+             onClick={() =&gt; flyToLocation(-104.523, 33.3943, 8, mapConfig, setMapConfig)}
+             className='px-3 py-1 rounded bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 transition-colors'&gt;
+             Roswell
+           &lt;/button&gt;
+           &lt;button
+             type='button'
+             onClick={() =&gt; {
+               setVisualizationMode('native')
+               setMapConfig({
+                 center: [-98.5795, 39.8283] as [number, number],
+                 zoom: [3] as [number],
+                 pitch: [45] as [number],
+               })
+             }}
+             className='px-3 py-1 rounded bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 transition-colors'&gt;
+             Reset View
+           &lt;/button&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Statistics panel */}
+       &lt;div className='absolute top-4 right-4 p-4 bg-black bg-opacity-70 text-white rounded-lg z-10 font-monumentMono'&gt;
+         &lt;h3 className='text-lg mb-2 font-bold text-cyan-400'&gt;Current View&lt;/h3&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Sightings count with filter info */}
+         &lt;div className='flex justify-between items-center'&gt;
+           &lt;p className='text-sm'&gt;
+             {isFiltering ? (
+               &lt;span className='text-cyan-400 flex items-center'&gt;
+                 &lt;svg
+                   className='animate-spin -ml-1 mr-2 h-4 w-4 text-cyan-400'
+                   xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'
+                   fill='none'
+                   viewBox='0 0 24 24'&gt;
+                   &lt;circle
+                     className='opacity-25'
+                     cx='12'
+                     cy='12'
+                     r='10'
+                     stroke='currentColor'
+                     strokeWidth='4'
+                   /&gt;
+                   &lt;path
+                     className='opacity-75'
+                     fill='currentColor'
+                     d='M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z'
+                   /&gt;
+                 &lt;/svg&gt;
+                 Filtering...
+               &lt;/span&gt;
+             ) : filters.isSignificantEvent ? (
+               &lt;span className='text-yellow-400'&gt;
+                 Showing {filteredSightings?.features?.length || 0} major events
+               &lt;/span&gt;
+             ) : (
+               &lt;span&gt;Showing {filteredSightings?.features?.length || 0} sightings&lt;/span&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/p&gt;
+ 
+           {/* Filter indicators */}
+           {(filters.shape || filters.duration &gt; 0 || filters.country) &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className='text-xs text-cyan-300 ml-2'&gt;
+               &lt;span&gt;Filtered&lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Time range */}
+         &lt;p className='text-sm'&gt;
+           Time range: {formatDate(timeRange[0])} - {formatDate(timeRange[1])}
+         &lt;/p&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Active filters summary */}
+         {(filters.shape || filters.duration &gt; 0 || filters.country) &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div className='text-xs mt-1 border-t border-gray-700 pt-1'&gt;
+             &lt;p className='text-cyan-400'&gt;Active filters:&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;div className='flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1'&gt;
+               {filters.shape &amp;&amp; (
+                 &lt;span className='px-1 py-0.5 bg-gray-800 rounded text-cyan-300'&gt;
+                   Shape: {filters.shape}
+                 &lt;/span&gt;
+               )}
+               {filters.duration &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+                 &lt;span className='px-1 py-0.5 bg-gray-800 rounded text-cyan-300'&gt;
+                   {filters.duration &gt;= 3600
+                     ? &#96;${filters.duration / 3600}h+&#96;
+                     : &#96;${filters.duration / 60}m+&#96;}
+                 &lt;/span&gt;
+               )}
+               {filters.country &amp;&amp; (
+                 &lt;span className='px-1 py-0.5 bg-gray-800 rounded text-cyan-300'&gt;
+                   {filters.country.toUpperCase()}
+                   {filters.state &amp;&amp; &#96;: ${filters.state.toUpperCase()}&#96;}
+                 &lt;/span&gt;
+               )}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {/* Data source info */}
+         {useExtData &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;p className='text-sm text-cyan-300 mt-2'&gt;
+             Using {sightings?.features?.length || 0} sightings from external data
+           &lt;/p&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {/* Animation status */}
+         {isAnimating &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div className='mt-2 border-t border-cyan-800 pt-2'&gt;
+             &lt;p className='text-sm text-yellow-400 font-bold'&gt;Time Animation Active&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;p className='text-xs'&gt;
+               Currently showing: {month}/{year}
+             &lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;div className='w-full h-1 bg-gray-700 rounded-full mt-1 overflow-hidden'&gt;
+               &lt;div
+                 className='h-full bg-yellow-500'
+                 style={{
+                   width: &#96;${
+                     (((year - 1940) * 12 + month) / ((new Date().getFullYear() - 1940) * 12)) * 100
+                   }%&#96;,
+                 }}
+               /&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             {/* Count significant events in current period */}
+             {filteredSightings?.features &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className='mt-1 text-xs'&gt;
+                 &lt;span className='text-yellow-300'&gt;
+                   {filteredSightings.features.filter((f) =&gt; isSignificantEvent(f))?.length || 0}{' '}
+                   significant events
+                 &lt;/span&gt;
+                 {' / '}
+                 &lt;span&gt;{filteredSightings.features?.length || 0} total sightings&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
```

```diff
+ # Sightings Globe Component Structure
+ 
+ This directory contains the Sightings Globe visualization component, which displays UFO sightings data on an interactive map. The component has been organized into smaller, reusable pieces to improve maintainability and clarity.
+ 
+ ## Component Structure
+ 
+ ### Main Components
+ 
+ - &#96;sightings-globe.tsx&#96; - The original monolithic component (kept for reference)
+ - &#96;sightings-globe-refactored.tsx&#96; - The refactored main component that uses the extracted components
+ 
+ ### Extracted Components
+ 
+ - &#96;components/deck-gl-overlay.tsx&#96; - Helper component for attaching deck.gl overlays to a Mapbox map
+ 
+ ### Custom Hooks
+ 
+ - &#96;hooks/use-map-initialization.tsx&#96; - Hook for handling map initialization and loading
+ - &#96;hooks/use-visualization-layers.tsx&#96; - Hook for building deck.gl visualization layers
+ - &#96;useTimeSeriesAnimation.tsx&#96; - Hook for managing animation of time series data (existing)
+ - &#96;use-batched-processing.ts&#96; - Hook for efficient batch processing of large datasets (existing)
+ 
+ ### Utilities
+ 
+ - &#96;utils/sighting-filters.ts&#96; - Filtering functions for sightings data
+ - &#96;utils/map-utils.ts&#96; - Utility functions for map operations
+ - &#96;utils/date-utils.ts&#96; - Date formatting and handling utilities
+ 
+ ### Types
+ 
+ - &#96;types.ts&#96; - Shared TypeScript types and interfaces
+ 
+ ## Custom Layers
+ 
+ - &#96;animated-arc-layer.tsx&#96; - Custom layer for animated arcs (existing)
+ - &#96;animated-arc-group-layer.tsx&#96; - Layer for grouping animated arcs (existing)
+ 
+ ## How to Use
+ 
+ To use the refactored Sightings Globe component:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;jsx
+ import { SightingsGlobe } from './sightings-globe-refactored'
+ 
+ // Sample data
+ const geoJSONSightings = {
+   sightings: { /* GeoJSON FeatureCollection */ },
+   militaryBases: { /* GeoJSON FeatureCollection */ },
+   ufoPosts: { /* GeoJSON FeatureCollection */ }
+ }
+ 
+ function App() {
+   return &lt;SightingsGlobe geoJSONSightings={geoJSONSightings} /&gt;
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Features
+ 
+ - Multiple visualization modes (heatmap, hexagon clusters, scatter plot, arcs, etc.)
+ - Time-based filtering with animation
+ - Detailed popups for sighting information
+ - Filtering by shape, duration, country, and more
+ - Special highlighting for significant events
+ - Shows related data layers (military bases, UFO posts)
+
```

Here's a summary of the components I've extracted from the sightings-globe.tsx file:

1. **Types (`types.ts`)**
   - Contains shared interfaces like `DeckProps`, `SightingsGlobeProps`, `FeatureInfo`, `GeoJSONFeature`, etc.
   - Centralizes type definitions for better maintainability

2. **DeckGLOverlay Component (`components/deck-gl-overlay.tsx`)**
   - A focused component that handles integration between Mapbox and deck.gl
   - Responsible for attaching the deck.gl overlay to the map

3. **Sighting Filters (`utils/sighting-filters.ts`)**
   - Contains filtering functions like `isSignificantEvent` and `filterFeature`
   - Makes filtering logic reusable and testable

4. **Map Utilities (`utils/map-utils.ts`)**
   - Contains `flyToLocation`, `getUserLocation`, `loadMapboxTileset` and `formatDate`
   - Isolates map-specific operations

5. **Visualization Layers Hook (`hooks/use-visualization-layers.tsx`)**
   - Encapsulates the visualization layer building logic
   - Separates deck.gl layer creation from the main component

6. **Map Initialization Hook (`hooks/use-map-initialization.tsx`)**
   - Handles map loading and initialization
   - Manages the complex map initialization process

7. **Refactored Main Component (`sightings-globe-refactored.tsx`)**
   - Uses the extracted components and hooks
   - Remains responsible for state management and UI rendering
   - More focused on layout and user interaction

The refactoring offers several benefits:
- Improved code organization and separation of concerns
- Better testability of individual functions and components
- Easier maintenance as each module has a single responsibility
- Reusability of components like filters and map utilities
- Clearer code structure through proper type definitions

This architecture follows modern React practices by leveraging hooks, breaking down complex functionality into smaller units, and maintaining clean separation between UI components and logic.
